tunnel.status.create.conflict_unmatched.note: Printed when Radient answers 409 (already exists) to a retried create and no single tunnel on this login matches the pending request. Commands (lop …), 127.0.0.1:{port}, HTTP, 5xx and <id> stay verbatim.

tunnel.status.gateway.listening_http_sta.note: The gateway port answered its health route with a non-200 HTTP status. {port} is a TCP port; {status} is an HTTP status code such as 500 (both pre-formatted). Commands (lop …), 127.0.0.1:{port}, HTTP, 5xx and <id> stay verbatim.

tunnel.status.gateway.listening_timed_ou.note: The gateway port accepted a connection but its health route did not answer in time. {port} is a TCP port number (pre-formatted, no grouping). Commands (lop …), 127.0.0.1:{port}, HTTP, 5xx and <id> stay verbatim.

tunnel.status.gateway.listening_unreadab.note: The gateway port answered with something that is not a health payload. {port} is a TCP port number (pre-formatted). Commands (lop …), 127.0.0.1:{port}, HTTP, 5xx and <id> stay verbatim.

tunnel.status.last_exit.at.note: {label} is a short reason label; {at} is a clock time (HH:MM) or date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), already formatted. History of the connector's last retrying exit, which may be old.

tunnel.status.last_exit.plain.note: {label} is an already-localized short reason label (e.g. 'Radient server error'). Used when the exit time is unknown.

tunnel.status.login.deferred_retried.note: Shown when a sign-in refresh was deferred and the connector row above already explains the wait. 'Login:' is the row label; keep it as a label.

tunnel.status.login.unchecked.note: The login check could not run (network). Must never read as an expired sign-in. 'Login:' is the row label.

tunnel.status.requests.heading.role: Diagnostic heading in lop tunnel status / lop mobile status
tunnel.status.requests.heading.note: {window} is how many request-log entries were read (pre-formatted integer); {tally} is a machine tally such as '2xx=4 5xx=1' and stays verbatim.

tunnel.status.requests.no_response.role: Status cell in a request-log row
tunnel.status.requests.no_response.note: Shown in place of an HTTP status for a request that ended without any response (what the phone reports as Not answering).

tunnel.status.server_unavailable.label.note: Label for reason code server_unavailable: Radient answered with HTTP 5xx. Shown after 'Last connector exit:' and in status rows.

tunnel.status.server_unavailable.relay.note: Shown on the phone when the computer's gateway refuses relayed requests because Radient answered with a server error. Names no command (the phone cannot run one).

tunnel.status.server_unavailable.termina.role: lop tunnel status / desktop connector detail
tunnel.status.server_unavailable.termina.note: The connector's authorization check got HTTP 5xx from Radient. Self-clearing; must not suggest signing in again. Commands (lop …), 127.0.0.1:{port}, HTTP, 5xx and <id> stay verbatim.
